messages:
Ashley: Quick personal update 1414 — I accepted an internal promotion to Senior Product Manager starting next Monday. Wanted to share here since you're the best supportive chaos crew :sparkles: :tada:
Raj: Huge congrats Ashley!! So proud of you :raised_hands: When's the celebratory stand-up cake?
Kae: OMG congrats!! We should do a tiny 10-min shoutout at 3pm and get a dessert. I'll bring mini eclairs.
Nina: Congratulations!! You've earned it. Quick plug: I'm making a little promo card with quotes from teammates. Reply here with one sentence about Ashley (& keep it PG)
Ashley: Thank you all, seriously. I appreciate it. A short shoutout works great. Also if remote folks want to join, happy to set up a Zoom link.
PeopleOps: Congrats Ashley 389 PeopleOps note: we can order a small gift (up to $75) for role changes. DM me preferred delivery details.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Ashley Promo Shoutout" Tomorrow 3:00pm-3:15pm, Location: SF kitchen + Zoom. RSVP requested.
GIFBot: GIF posted: https://giphy.com/gifs/congrats-yes-3oEduSbSGpGaRX2Vri
Raj: I'll take a photo and post in #random. Also Nina, "sharp prioritization instincts" is my sentence.
Kae: "Never misses the tiny user pain" is mine.
Nina: "Turns bug triage into performance art" 602 from me.
Ashley: These are beautiful and hilarious. Thank you. See you at 3pm (I'll bring the forks) :fork_and_knife:
Raj: Congrats again!! Also reminder: cake cleared by 5pm per Facilities.
PeopleOps: Congrats again Ashley 970 — badge of honor unlocked.
